description: This file defines a Java interface named 'EcuDerivedParameterConvertor' within the package 'com.romraider.logger.ecu.definition'. The interface extends another interface 'EcuDataConvertor' and declares a method 'setEcuDatas' which takes an array of 'EcuData'. This interface appears to be part of a larger ECU data handling or conversion framework for the RomRaider project.

classes.name: EcuDerivedParameterConvertor
classes.description: A Java interface for converting derived ECU parameters, extending the basic data conversion capabilities, and specifying a method to set multiple ECU data instances.

methods.name: setEcuDatas
methods.description: Sets the ECU data array for the converter, allowing it to process multiple ECU data instances.
